steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing weekend with Maria. Would you like help turning that into an email or message to share? I can draft or send one for you. Below are three short options you can use; tell me which you want (or edit) and whether to send or save as a draft.

1) Informal note to friends/family
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Hi — I spent a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria. We explored nature trails, soaked up the fresh air, and had a great time unwinding. Thought I’d share a little escape — hope you’re well!
— [Your name]

2) Quick update to coworkers / OOO-style
Subject: Quick note — offline this past weekend
Hi team — I took a short trip to the countryside with my sister Maria over the weekend and spent some time hiking and relaxing. I’m back now and catching up on messages. Let me know if anything urgent popped up while I was offline.
Thanks, [Your name]

3) Short social-media style caption
Spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria — nature trails, fresh air, and full relaxation. Perfect reset.

Which version do you want, and should I send it (and to whom) or save it as a draft?
